datasets.name: warehouses
queryLines:
SELECT
  warehouse_id,
  warehouse_name,
  warehouse_type,
  warehouse_size,
  warehouse_channel,
  min_clusters,
  max_clusters,
  auto_stop_minutes,
  CASE
    WHEN delete_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deleted'
    ELSE 'Active'
  END AS status,
  change_time
FROM
  system.compute.warehouses
WHERE
  workspace_id = '7474654445014356'
QUALIFY
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1

datasets.name: warehouse_options
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  query_source.genie_space_id AS genie_agent
FROM
  system.query.history
WHERE
  workspace_id = '7474654445014356'
  AND query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL
  AND start_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
ORDER BY
  genie_agent

datasets.name: query_volume_trend
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('DAY', start_time) AS query_date,
  compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
  COUNT(*) AS query_count,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_duration_ms,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_duration_ms
FROM
  system.query.history
WHERE
  workspace_id = '7474654445014356'
  AND (
    :date_range.min IS NULL
    OR start_time >= :date_range.min
  )
  AND (
    :date_range.max IS NULL
    OR start_time <= :date_range.max
  )
  AND query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL
  AND statement_text NOT LIKE '%__databricks_internal%'
  AND (:genie_filter IS NULL OR array_contains(:genie_filter, query_source.genie_space_id))
GROUP BY
  1,
  2
ORDER BY

datasets.name: pruning_by_table
queryLines:
WITH extracted AS (
  SELECT
    statement_id,
    total_duration_ms,
    pruned_files,
    read_files,
    read_bytes,
    pruned_files_bytes,
    read_files_bytes,
    REPLACE(t.table_ref, '`', '') AS table_name
  FROM
    system.query.history
    LATERAL VIEW
      EXPLODE(
        regexp_extract_all(
          statement_text,
          '(?i)(?:FROM|JOIN)\\s+(`?[a-zA-Z0-9_]+`?\\.`?[a-zA-Z0-9_]+`?\\.`?[a-zA-Z0-9_]+`?)'
        )
      ) t
      AS table_ref
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '7474654445014356'
    AND query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      :date_range.min IS NULL
      OR start_time >= :date_range.min
    )
    AND (
      :date_range.max IS NULL
      OR start_time <= :date_range.max
    )
    AND (
      :genie_filter IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:genie_filter, query_source.genie_space_id)
    )
    AND pruned_files IS NOT NULL
    AND (pruned_files + read_files) > 0
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    table_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT statement_id) AS query_count,
    SUM(read_bytes) AS total_read_bytes,
    SUM(read_files) AS total_read_files,
    ROUND(AVG(pruned_files + read_files), 0) AS avg_total_files,
    ROUND(SUM(read_files_bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(read_files), 0) / 1048576, 2) AS avg_file_size_mb,
    AVG(CAST(pruned_files AS DOUBLE) / (pruned_files + read_files)) AS avg_file_pruning_ratio,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN
          (pruned_files_bytes + read_files_bytes) > 0
        THEN
          CAST(pruned_files_bytes AS DOUBLE) / (pruned_files_bytes + read_files_bytes)
      END
    ) AS avg_bytes_pruning_ratio,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_duration_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_duration_ms
  FROM
    extracted
  WHERE
    table_name NOT LIKE '%__databricks_internal%'
  GROUP BY
    table_name
)
SELECT
  *,
  CASE
    WHEN
      avg_total_files >= 100
      AND avg_file_size_mb < 32
    THEN
      'Small files: run OPTIMIZE or enable predictive optimization'
    WHEN
      avg_total_files >= 100
      AND avg_file_pruning_ratio < 0.5
    THEN
      'Low pruning: add liquid clustering on columns Genie filters by'
    ELSE 'No action needed'
  END AS recommended_action
FROM
  agg
ORDER BY
  total_read_bytes DESC

datasets.name: genie_perf
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    query_source.genie_space_id AS genie_space_id,
    compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
    COUNT(*) AS query_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_duration_ms, 0.25) AS p25_total_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_total_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_duration_ms, 0.75) AS p75_total_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_total_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(waiting_for_compute_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_wait_compute_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(waiting_for_compute_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_wait_compute_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_wait_capacity_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_wait_capacity_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(execution_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_execution_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(execution_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_execution_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(compilation_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_compilation_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(compilation_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_compilation_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_task_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_task_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(total_task_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_task_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(result_fetch_duration_ms, 0.50) AS p50_fetch_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(result_fetch_duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99_fetch_ms,
    COALESCE(AVG(waiting_for_compute_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_wait_compute_ms,
    COALESCE(AVG(waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_wait_capacity_ms,
    COALESCE(AVG(compilation_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_compilation_ms,
    COALESCE(AVG(execution_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_execution_ms,
    COALESCE(AVG(result_fetch_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_fetch_ms
  FROM
    system.query.history
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '7474654445014356'
    AND query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL
    AND statement_text NOT LIKE '%__databricks_internal%'
    AND (
      :date_range.min IS NULL
      OR start_time >= :date_range.min
    )
    AND (
      :date_range.max IS NULL
      OR start_time <= :date_range.max
    )
    AND (
      :genie_filter IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:genie_filter, query_source.genie_space_id)
    )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN
        avg_wait_capacity_ms
          >= GREATEST(avg_wait_compute_ms, avg_compilation_ms, avg_execution_ms, avg_fetch_ms)
      THEN
        'Queueing at capacity'
      WHEN
        avg_wait_compute_ms >= GREATEST(avg_compilation_ms, avg_execution_ms, avg_fetch_ms)
      THEN
        'Compute startup'
      WHEN avg_compilation_ms >= GREATEST(avg_execution_ms, avg_fetch_ms) THEN 'Compilation'
      WHEN avg_execution_ms >= avg_fetch_ms THEN 'Execution'
      ELSE 'Result fetch'
    END AS primary_bottleneck
  FROM
    base
)
SELECT
  *,
  CASE primary_bottleneck
    WHEN
      'Queueing at capacity'
    THEN
      'Raise max clusters (scaling) or give this Genie agent a dedicated warehouse'
    WHEN 'Compute startup' THEN 'Use serverless or lengthen auto-stop so the warehouse stays warm'
    WHEN
      'Compilation'
    THEN
      'Simplify tables/views exposed to Genie (fewer nested views and joins); keep stats current with ANALYZE'
    WHEN
      'Execution'
    THEN
      'Improve pruning (liquid clustering, OPTIMIZE) or size up the warehouse; see pruning tables below'
    ELSE 'Return smaller results: aggregate or LIMIT in Genie instructions and example SQL'
  END AS recommended_action
FROM
  tagged
ORDER BY
  query_count DESC

datasets.name: worst_pruned
queryLines:
SELECT
  statement_id,
  query_source.genie_space_id AS genie_space_id,
  compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
  LEFT(statement_text, 200) AS statement_snippet,
  total_duration_ms,
  pruned_files,
  read_files,
  pruned_files + read_files AS total_files,
  ROUND(read_files_bytes / NULLIF(read_files, 0) / 1048576, 2) AS avg_file_size_mb,
  ROUND(
    CAST(pruned_files AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(pruned_files + read_files, 0),
    4
  ) AS file_pruning_ratio,
  read_bytes,
  read_rows,
  pruned_files_bytes,
  read_files_bytes,
  ROUND(
    CAST(pruned_files_bytes AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(pruned_files_bytes + read_files_bytes, 0),
    4
  ) AS bytes_pruning_ratio,
  start_time
FROM
  system.query.history
WHERE
  workspace_id = '7474654445014356'
  AND query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (pruned_files + read_files) > 0
  AND statement_text NOT LIKE '%__databricks_internal%'
  AND (
    :date_range.min IS NULL
    OR start_time >= :date_range.min
  )
  AND (
    :date_range.max IS NULL
    OR start_time <= :date_range.max
  )
  AND (
    :genie_filter IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:genie_filter, query_source.genie_space_id)
  )
ORDER BY
  file_pruning_ratio ASC,
  read_bytes DESC
LIMIT 100

lines: One-stop view of Genie agent query latency, where the time goes, warehouse configuration, and table pruning/file layout, with recommended actions. Filter by Genie Agent and date range.

frame.title: Daily Genie Query Volume by Warehouse

lines:
### Metric definitions and actions
| Metric | Definition | If high, it means | Concrete action |
|---|---|---|---|
| total_duration_ms | End-to-end wall-clock time of the statement | Slow Genie answers | Use the phase metrics below to find the bottleneck |
| waiting_for_compute_duration_ms | Time waiting for the warehouse to start or provision compute | Cold starts | Use serverless; lengthen auto-stop for the Genie warehouse |
| waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms | Time queued because all clusters were at max concurrency | Warehouse is saturated | Raise max clusters, or give Genie a dedicated warehouse |
| compilation_duration_ms | Parsing, analysis, optimization and metadata loading (Delta log, file listing) | Complex views/joins or heavy metadata (often many small files) | Simplify views exposed to Genie, run OPTIMIZE, keep stats current with ANALYZE |
| execution_duration_ms | Wall-clock time spent executing the plan | Large scans or under-sized warehouse | Improve pruning (liquid clustering), size up warehouse |
| total_task_duration_ms | Sum of all task time across all cores; can far exceed wall-clock | Total compute work; high vs execution = heavy scan | Reduce data read via pruning; larger size if parallelism is maxed |
| result_fetch_duration_ms | Time returning results to the client | Large result sets | Aggregate or LIMIT in Genie instructions and example SQL |
| read_files / pruned_files | Files scanned vs files skipped via data skipping | Low pruning = full scans | Cluster on columns Genie filters by |
| total files (pruned + read) | Files in scope of the table snapshot; proxy for table size in files | Many files | Check avg file size |
| read_files_bytes / pruned_files_bytes | Bytes scanned vs bytes skipped | Same as files, weighted by size | Same as above |
| avg file size (MB) | read_files_bytes / read_files | Under ~32 MB with 100+ files = small files problem | OPTIMIZE or enable predictive optimization (target ~128 MB-1 GB) |

*Per-table figures come from table names parsed from SQL text; multi-table queries attribute query-level metrics to each table.*
